name: Reconciliation Category 4
definition: Specifies categories of statuses of a derivative when there is no reporting requirement for both counterparties.

Revived.name: Revived
Revived.definition: Indicator of derivative reopening, terminated or cancelled by mistake.

FurtherModification.name: Further Modification
FurtherModification.definition: Indicator of modification to the terms or details of a previously reported derivative, at a trade or position level.
